scope: Two stationary separated positive thin lenses with stable IDs in unit-index air; paraxial propagation toward +x. Request focus under collimated output and a signed angular gain with an explicit unaided reference. Preparatory protocol only.

cases.facts: Objective 4 mm and eyepiece 25 mm, tube length 160 mm, output at infinity, least distinct-vision distance 250 mm.
cases.interpretation: Require tube-length convention. In the ideal model a mechanical lens-to-lens separation and a focal-plane interval are distinct. Return conditionally labelled signed gain, magnitude and the implied real object position. Do not choose a convention from the expected answer.
cases.expect: With mechanical separation 160 mm, objective image distance 135 mm and signed angular magnification -327.5 relative to unaided viewing at 250 mm (objective magnification -131/4, eyepiece factor 250/25). With optical focal-plane interval 160 mm, separation 189 mm and signed gain -400.

cases.facts: Positive objective 0.50 m, positive eyepiece 0.05 m; Moon then object 10 m away; unchanged accommodation.
cases.interpretation: Treat the Moon as collimated input and explicitly assume relaxed/parallel output for both settings. For the finite case declare distance measured from objective. Specify reference for unaided angle; eye at eyepiece and objective-plane reference differ at finite distance.
cases.expect: Initial spacing 0.55 m, signed angular gain -10. Near spacing 10/19 + 1/20 m, outward shift 1/38 m, objective-referenced angular gain -200/19. For the same object referred to an eye at the eyepiece, multiply that last gain by (10 m + near spacing)/(10 m).

controls: No signed angular gain without defined comparison angle and conjugate condition. Preserve real-positive objective image and separated lens admissibility.
Test exact finite and infinite conjugates, near singular inputs, mechanically impossible branches and unit/reference changes.

Use two actual pinned IdealLens instances at separated planes for off-axis, finite-height control bundles. Measure outgoing directions at native callbacks after both lenses. Do not equate sampled rays with a continuous image or silently assume pupil geometry.
Preserve public common-plane power and source/provenance contracts. No native core changes.
